'''Manambu''' is one of the [[Ndu languages]] of [[Sepik River]] region of northern [[Papua New Guinea]]. A Manambu-based [[pidgin]] is used with speakers of [[Kwoma language|Kwoma]]. Manambu has been extensively documented by [[Alexandra Aikhenvald]] in a comprehensive grammar.
